objective: Bootstrap the application baseline with a minimal accessible root route and a reproducible test/build foundation.

criteria.promise: The application root route renders the mmoptibuilds parent-brand heading as a semantic level-one heading.
The root document exposes truthful baseline metadata identifying mmoptibuilds without prices or unsupported proof.
The repository smoke test independently checks the root heading and passes through the package test command.
The bootstrap foundation passes the repository-native lint, typecheck, unit, Next build, and OpenNext build gates.

verification_gates.procedure: From starter, run npm run build and inspect the generated root route, then read app/page.tsx.
verification_gates.expected: Next build exits 0 and app/page.tsx contains one semantic h1 whose accessible name includes mmoptibuilds.

verification_gates.procedure: Read starter/app/layout.tsx and inspect the root metadata declaration.
verification_gates.expected: Metadata names mmoptibuilds truthfully and contains no public pricing, fabricated proof, or unsupported claim.
Vitest exits 0 and the focused smoke test asserts the root h1 by accessible role/name.

verification_gates.procedure: From starter, run npm run lint; npm run typecheck; npm test; npm run build; npm run cf:build.
verification_gates.expected: All five commands exit 0 with no lint warnings and no type, test, Next, or OpenNext build errors.

first_checkpoint.evidence: First coherent app/page.tsx plus app/layout.tsx and the focused smoke-test scaffold.
